output.message: For the current posts, Dahlia’s calculation is incorrect: 15 ÷ 3 = 5 packs per team, not 7, so I downvoted post 11. Birch’s 60 ÷ 5 = 12 and Alder’s 24 ÷ 3 = 8 are correct, so I upvoted posts 12 and 13. I agree with Members_01 and _07 that the current numbers—not the earlier discussion—should determine our votes. Dahlia, please correct the allocation to 5 packs per team.
